title: The Veterans' Shrine
text: A cairn of old swords, spears and axes stands by the road, each laid by someone who came back from the Gate one time too many. Rust bleeds into the stones. There is room for one more.

options.label: The one who has been out most often lays something down, leaving a little of the Gate behind.

outcomes.text: Leaving it is easier than they thought. They walk away lighter.

options.label: The Leader takes the best of the old weapons; good steel should not rust.

outcomes.text: The old blade is fine. It does not want to be here, and it does not want to be with you either.

options.label: Salute the cairn and move on.

outcomes.text: There is a little peace in seeing the old iron rust in the rain.
